title: Dual CNF computes the negation of a DNF
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ variables — a disjunction of terms, each term a conjunction of literals — and let $x \in \{0,1\}^n$ be an assignment. Form its De~Morgan dual CNF by negating every literal of every term of $\varphi$ and reading each resulting term as a clause (a disjunction of literals), so that the whole is a conjunction of clauses. Then this dual CNF evaluates on $x$ to the negation of the value of $\varphi$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: φ is a DNF on n variables
x is an assignment Fin n → Bool
replaced:
For every input $x : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Bool}$, the dual CNF evaluates to the
negation of the original DNF: $\mathrm{CNF.eval}\,(\mathrm{dnfToDualCNF}\,\varphi)\,x
= \neg(\mathrm{DNF.eval}\,\varphi\,x)$.
